instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME SETUP: Update `app/frontend/src/index.css` with the CSS variables provided in `colors.css_overrides`. This is CRITICAL for the dark mode look.
2. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to `app/frontend/src/index.css` at the very top.
3. LAYOUT: Use the 'Bento Grid' strategy. Don't just stack cards. Use `col-span-2` or `row-span-2` to create visual interest.
4. GLASSMORPHISM: Apply the `card.classes` to all main containers. Do not use solid opaque backgrounds for cards.
5. LANGUAGE: Ensure all UI text (labels, buttons, headers) is in INDONESIAN as requested.
6. CHARTS: Use `recharts` (via Shadcn charts). Style them with the `primary` (Cyan) and `secondary` (Blue) colors. Avoid default rainbow colors.
7. FORMS: Split long forms (Vessel Input) into logical sections (e.g., 'Informasi Kapal', 'Muatan', 'Waktu'). Use `Card` components to group them.
8. TESTING: Add `data-testid` to all inputs and buttons (e.g., `data-testid='submit-vessel-btn'`).
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
